audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3 and 4 read 'Skill' and row 6 read 'Kennen' in both layers, contradicting the packet chart (Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Skill) and the already-audited mirror, which set exactly those three rows.
audit.why: The page's own whys[3] and whys[4] describe Kennen owning 4-5 and 6, and whys[6] describes Lucian reclaiming the 1v1 at items — the sides were simply inverted against the prose.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 set to Kennen, row 6 to Skill, as matched full/content pairs, ratings re-scaled to 3/10 and 2/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Do #3 sold a 'fifteen-second invitation' off Lightning Rush; Lightning Rush is 10/9/8/7/6s. phases[4] still called level 6 Lucian's ult spike.
audit.why: A player counting fifteen seconds off a ten-second escape steps into a Kennen who already has it back. Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s and is the level-6 swing.
audit.corrected: The E cooldown corrected to ten seconds; phases[4].why now names Slicing Maelstrom, the third mark and the 120s cooldown.
sources: enemyKit Kennen E cd 10/9/8/7/6, R cd 120

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page told the player that Kennen's stun arms Lightslinger, and nothing addressed Electrical Surge's on-hit magic damage flagged in missingInteractions.
audit.why: Riot's Lightslinger text: 'when a nearby enemy Champion is immobilized, his next 2 basic attacks will deal bonus magic damage'. Mark of the Storm's stun triggers that clause, so surviving the stun leaves your return trade empowered. Separately Electrical Surge is on-hit magic damage scaling with attack speed, so armour misreads the trade — the answer is MR.
audit.corrected: Both written in: the Lightslinger trigger into report[5].t, the MR-not-armour point into dontsFull[0].d alongside his 950-to-500 range edge.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'Ardent Blaze' in wants.you[1] as a probable wrong name.
audit.why: Ardent Blaze is the real Riot name of Lucian's W. This is a false positive in suspectNames — the kit file confirms it.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Lightning Rush — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: He keeps the poke edge and any long trade builds toward a Mark of the Storm stun your base HP cannot survive.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom plus a third mark stun-locks you through your E — his hardest all-in, on a flat 120s.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: First-item power lets you E-onto-W burst him, but his AoE R reclaims teamfights — close the lane, then group.

edits.before: Track Kennen’s Lightning Rush: His engage and escape — the stun chain starts here. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Lightning Rush is 170 range, 10s at rank 1. His mark stun also arms Lightslinger — eat it and your next two autos hit harder.

edits.before: Kennen burns Lightning Rush on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Kennen burns Lightning Rush on nothing — that is a ten-second invitation.

edits.before: That’s Kennen’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: His Q reaches 950 to your 500 and Electrical Surge is on-hit magic — MR, not armour.

notes: The content-layer prose blocks (early, mid, late) for this matchup are written in FIRST PERSON — 'my one clean window', 'I can't out-poke' — while every other Lucian matchup uses the second-person voice ('you'). That is a voice defect across three long fields; rewriting all three inside the ±10% band is possible but it is a stylistic call, so I left them and am flagging it for a champion-level pass. Also, the full layer refers to Kennen correctly as 'he' here, unlike the karma and kayle pages.
